parameters.name: moduleId
parameters.description: The module ID. This parameter is valid and required when resourceType is set to Module.

parameters.name: moduleName
parameters.description: The name of the module. This parameter is valid and required when resourceType is set to RegistryModule.

parameters.name: namespaceName
parameters.description: The workspace name. This parameter is valid and required when resourceType is set to RegistryModule.

parameters.name: resourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource. Valid values:
- Module
- RegistryModule.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The local zip file to upload. The file size cannot exceed 10 MB.
